name: The Bay Clinic Pattaya

summary_en: Located in Bang Lamung, The Bay Clinic Pattaya specializes in facial treatments, laser, Botox, and fillers, holding a 4.7 rating from 48 reviews. Patients highlight the gentle technique of the doctors and the polite service provided by the staff. There are currently 0 Pantip discussions regarding this clinic.
